Three Speculative Claims


   1. Features are the fundamental unit of neural
      networks. They correspond to directions.
      These features can be rigorously studied and
      understood.

   2. Features are connected by weights, forming
      circuits. These circuits can also be rigorously
      studied and understood.

   3. Universality: Analogous features and circuits
      form across models and tasks.

    ▶ Conﬁdence-reducing features (cf. negative name movers in IOI)
